title.narrative: Abidjan Integrated Sustainable Urban Planning and Management

description.narrative: The Project aims to enhance local capacity to assess and respond to environmental degradation through the application of integrated sustainable urban planning and management methods while encouraging the uptake of innovative lower carbon technologies to reduce GHG emissions and improve air quality in the city of Abidjan.
